title: Classic Korean Bibimbap with Fried Rice and Onigiri
description: A simple and flavorful Korean rice bowl dish with crispy fried rice, onigiri, and a variety of vegetables.
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the mushrooms, carrots, and zucchini. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Add the soy sauce and stir-fry for another minute.
Divide the rice mixture among four bowls.
Top each bowl with a fried egg and sprinkle with green onions.
Serve with onigiri on the side.
Sprinkle with Korean chili flakes and Old Bay seasoning to taste.
